paper.title: Impact of caloric restriction on health and survival in rhesus monkeys from the NIA study.

organism.source_quote: We report here that a CR regimen implemented in young and older age rhesus monkeys at the National Institute on Aging (NIA) has not improved survival outcomes.

experiments.notes: One record rather than a split by age cohort: the abstract's single survival statement covers both the young and the older monkeys together, so there is no separate result to attach to either and age_at_start spans both. The abstract explicitly contrasts this result with the ongoing WNPRC study (Colman 2009), which reported improved survival; WNPRC's dose and age range are that paper's data and are deliberately not transcribed into this record.
